parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but introduces a non-minimal change and potential maintainability issues.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the function for all Function types, not just the specific case of exp(). This may introduce unintended side effects.
The patch reduces maintainability by introducing a conditional check within the loop that processes function arguments, making the code less clear and more complex.
